tables_2.title:
INSTRUCTION TO SS
1. The following updated documents should be made available before commencement of trials:-
a. Service log of all equipment of GTA
b. EMAP revelant to MGTAs parameters.
c. Record of all adjustment made to elements of engines, RGs and controls.
d. ships displacement and drafts. State of POLs on board. Sl no. 10 & 11 will be undertaken during FPT.
2. During the entrie trial duration ensure following:-
a. Steady course and regime should be maintained.
b. Wheel over 5° to be avoided.
c. Gun trials/helo operation/maneuvering not be taken.
d. Log ships speed during each regime.
3. Engine room overhead and below platform to be fully illuminated.
4. Record of lube oil replacement for all 04 GTs to be provided.
